verification_limits: No complete characterization of arbitrary measurable pointwise obstacles is established.
The exact smooth-test theorem covers Lebesgue-almost-everywhere domination and lower-semicontinuous pointwise obstacles.
The general singular-measure test is proved necessary only.
All examples separating the claimed scopes are finite-valued nonnegative Borel functions.
Standard functional analysis and measure theory are used explicitly; no novelty or full literature exhaustiveness is claimed.
Portable finite controls do not replace the analytic proofs or fresh independent review.
Only authored proofs, authored code, and public verification metadata are included in the authored packet.
